name: Site A - Kalpetta North Plateau
description: 64.5 acres flat crystalline charnockite plateau with SPT N > 50 borehole verification, 4-lane NH766 connectivity, and 3-phase grid power.
reasons: Low landslide exposure on stable crystalline bedrock plateau.
High resettlement capacity (1200 households) capable of housing multi-settlement clusters.
Excellent arterial road connectivity to State Highway and Kalpetta district hub.
Existing 3-phase grid power, primary school, and water distribution within 1.5 km.

name: Site B - Meenangadi Model Township
description: 45 acres semi-terraced land with high-capacity storm drainage. Superior resilience under extreme cloudburst precipitation.
reasons: Moderate terrain safety with manageable slope gradient (<8°).
High resettlement capacity (850 households) capable of housing multi-settlement clusters.
Excellent arterial road connectivity to State Highway and Kalpetta district hub.
High drainage index allows exceptional performance during monsoon cloudbursts.

name: Site C - Sultan Bathery East
description: 28 acres adjacent to low-lying agrarian basin. Potential waterlogging during heavy precipitation peaks.
reasons: High terrain sensitivity requiring extensive slope engineering.
Adequate resettlement capacity (500 households) for targeted hamlet relocation.
Proximity to drainage channel requires buffer zone demarcation.

name: Site D - Vythiri Terraces
description: 32 acres terraced tea estate transition area. Requires reinforced gabion walls and retaining structures.
reasons: Moderate terrain safety with manageable slope gradient (<8°).
Adequate resettlement capacity (600 households) for targeted hamlet relocation.
Feasible road access; road widening and culvert upgrades required.
